about: Templates the mod places from its own code instead of through a pool or a worldgen structure (BUILDING_EDITING.md, Docks). Each entry names a blueprint in tools/village_blueprints/, the structure id it is compiled to (data/<namespace>/structure/<path>.nbt, outside village/) and its size, which the compiler checks. They join no pool, carry no jigsaws or entities, and stay out of the structure catalog.
